rationale: The assistant never asked whether 'e5' was the model or the error code, and it did not say to unplug the dock before cleaning. It still led the customer to clean the contacts, which was the right fix and resolved the problem. It gave a long generic list first, with some inaccuracies such as 'gold' contacts, 'i3/e5' hardware and a mention of a 'green light'. It also mentioned battery replacement only as a later option, so no unjustified part was pushed. The closing confidence is reasonable since the customer reported four clean nights.
rationale_note: Dock placement on carpet was mentioned in the generic list but not followed up after the fix.
